title: The Pinata Gauntlet! II
description: The Pinata Gauntlet! II — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: QuestGiver_B

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Destroy the Pinata and 4 Pinata Turrets in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Quest Reward: Gold and 1 King's Coin

Return to: QuestGiver_B

Repeatable: No

Zone: Ratsputin's Gulag (Quest)

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Destroy the Pinata and 4 Pinata Turrets in the Pinata Gauntlet off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and return to the Excited Lad in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Offer:

It looks like you are ready for a bit more of a challenge. Well this go round will be a little bit harder since you will have to destroy the Pinata Turrets too! It's not like I want to see you have to respawn, but it does make me laugh! Just remember to keep moving and you should be ok.

Make your way to the entrance to the Pinata Invitational off of Level 6 of Ratsputin's Gulag and destroy the Pinata there. Before you are finished you will also need to destroy the four Pinata Turrets. When this is done return to me, the Excited Lad, here in Ratsputin's Holding Cell.

Turn-in:

Nicely done! And there isn't even a scratch on you. Although, there is a huge gaping hole where your spleen used to be. Let me know if you want to try this quest again.

Objectives:

  • Destroy the Pinata
  • Destroy Pinata Turrets

Client level range: 80–100
